{{Quote|How utterly romantic and human.|Darth Plagueis, to Cosinga Palpatine, regarding his grandfather|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[House Palpatine/Legends|House Palpatine]] was the '''grandfather''' of the human [[Noble/Legends|aristocrat]] [[Cosinga Palpatine]]. Around [[135 BBY/Legends|135 BBY]], the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] people were engaged in a [[Gungan–Naboo War|war]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], with [[House Tapalo]] and [[House Veruna]] providing the most funding to the mercenary army. When Palpatine's grandfather learned that the true reason for the war was access to Naboo's [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]], he challenged [[Tapalo]] to a duel that took place at House Palpatine's ancestral home, [[Convergence/Legends|Convergence]] on Naboo. Tapalo [[Death/Legends|killed]] him with his blade during their duel.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Around [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], at Convergence, Cosinga Palpatine told of the Gungan&ndash;Naboo War and his grandfather's fate to [[Magister]] Hego Damask, who was, in reality, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], in an attempt to demonstrate why Tapalo's son, [[Bon Tapalo/Legends|Bon Tapalo]], should not be elected as the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Monarch of Naboo]]. In response, Plagueis stated he considered Palpatine's grandfather's actions to be romantic and human.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cosinga Palpatine's grandfather was mentioned in [[James Luceno]]'s [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
